specs.details:
SUBJECT: hold the LEFT mouse button to charge, then RELEASE it to throw ONE card. Dark muted ink-blue field, ivory paper, golden active left button, one muted terracotta flying card.
COMPOSITION: two very large clearly separated horizontal illustrated stages stacked vertically, each with a pale ivory panel and generous gaps. Read top to bottom. Upper stage: a large simple computer mouse seen from above on the left, its LEFT half/button clearly gold, a very simple fingertip touching and pressing that left button. Beside it a BIG simple hourglass communicates holding/waiting. The right mouse button is ivory. One large downward arrow between stages conveys next action. Lower stage: the same computer mouse with BOTH buttons ivory, a fingertip visibly lifted above its LEFT button with a little upward separation arrow; next to this released mouse a big rightward arrow leads to ONE large tilted card flying away, with two or three thick motion streaks behind. Do not place the card touching the fingertip: this is a mouse input diagram with a separate game result. Never show a right button highlight. No letters and no digits anywhere. A sparse frame of two broad unequal curved blue/ivory strokes, no decorative symbols.
specs.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / stylized-concept. Asset: ONE complete tutorial instruction playing card for our handmade fantasy game, portrait 2:3, target 1024x1536, straight-on orthographic texture. Redraw the old instruction card from scratch for MAXIMUM instant readability at a small in-game size.

REFERENCES: image 1 is the old tutorial card: preserve its taught controls and color family, not its crude digital execution or identical zigzag border. Image 2 is our approved art style: very primitive irregular thick black marker outlines, naive asymmetric big shapes, a little flat dry-crayon texture, yellowed paper. Transfer its DRAWING style only. Do not copy its character, text, numbers, mushrooms, icons or tangled frame. Image 3 is the approved finished physical card carrier: rounded yellowed paper, flat color, restrained local edge wear. Transfer that paper/ink feeling only.

IMPORTANT TUTORIAL RULE: instructions are drawings and keyboard glyphs ONLY. No title, explanatory text, captions, numbers, cost, stat labels, elemental emblems or logo. Deliberate huge high-contrast pictograms, plenty of clear separation, no tiny details. The actual action must be understood from imagery. Key glyphs are large simple hand-lettered block shapes. Keep the same thick organic black line quality as approved cards; not clean corporate vector art, not pixel art, not realistic, not 3D. Warm ivory pictograms and muted golden input accents against the darker colored field. Inactive controls stay ivory; only relevant input is golden. Simple unique spare hand-drawn border, no repeated zigzag wallpaper. Paper wear limited to outer corners, never across a control/pictogram. Whole card visible, narrow transparent margin around all edges. TRUE RGBA alpha outside the physical rounded paper silhouette, opaque interior. No background, checkerboard, table, perspective, floating shadow, second card or mockup.

specs.details:
SUBJECT: four basic controls: WASD movement, mouse look, SHIFT sprint, SPACE jump. Dark muted forest-green field with golden ochre and warm ivory. Use FOUR distinct clean horizontal ivory strips separated by thick dark-green gaps, generously spaced. Each row maps an input on left to a simple action pictogram on right with a small bold rightward connecting arrow.
TOP ROW, tallest: FOUR big cream keycaps arranged correctly: W centered above A S D. Black hand-lettered glyphs W, A, S, D. On the right two simple chunky bootprint shapes with four directional arrows around them (movement). Do not invent extra letter keys.
SECOND ROW: a big recognizable top-down mouse on left, no pressed/highlighted button, with a short horizontal double-headed movement arrow underneath; right a big simple eye looking sideways, accompanied by a curved left-right looking arrow (look around).
THIRD ROW: one large golden keycap with exact hand-lettered "SHIFT"; on right a bold black running-person pictogram with bent limbs and two speed strokes.
BOTTOM ROW: one long golden horizontal spacebar with exact hand-lettered "SPACE"; on right a bold black person pictogram visibly in the air above a short ground line, with one big upward arrow (jump).
Only text allowed: W A S D SHIFT SPACE on their own keys. No Russian words, title, number, captions or small text. Keep pictograms childlike and thick, very simple, readable without faces. Frame sparse irregular interrupted ochre/ivory strokes, not ornate, not moss or branches.

specs.details:
SUBJECT: press R to DISCARD THE ENTIRE HAND of cards. A single clear vertical cause-and-effect composition. Dark muted aubergine field, warm ivory, golden key, muted lilac/terracotta cards.
TOP THIRD: one HUGE golden keyboard keycap labeled exactly "R" in black hand lettering, with a simple fingertip pressing its top edge and two short press emphasis marks. Below it, one big downward ivory arrow points toward the illustrated result.
LOWER TWO THIRDS: a big simple open palm at left-bottom, visibly EMPTY. Exactly THREE paper cards leave that palm together, all moving along the SAME bold downward/rightward curved arrow and falling into ONE separate loose discard pile at lower-right. The pile is just two overlapping flat cards lying almost horizontally on a short ground line. The three airborne cards are separated enough that all are immediately countable and have matching simple colored backs. Thick motion streaks convey all cards leaving the hand at once. No bin or trash can, no explosion, no new cards arriving, no crossed-out hand, no crossed-out key, no circular reload arrow. Make the downward discarding gesture unmistakable and much larger than decoration. Only text allowed anywhere is R on the keycap. A few long uneven lilac frame strokes with one bent corner, sparse and simple.
